messages:
maria: FYI: saw a ~4.2% NDCG@10 drop on news_dev after onboarding model gpt-rerank-2q with the new tokenizer. numbers below. not sure if it's quant or preproc. any ideas? :thinking_face:

kai: can you paste the eval command + seed?

maria: eval job: `./eval_run --model gpt-rerank-2q --tokenizer spm_new --dataset news_dev --seed 42 --truncate 1024 --preserve_prefix False`
Output: NDCG@10=0.673 (baseline 0.704) MRR=0.412 -> 0.434 previously

raj: did we change normalization? spm_new strips punctuation by default. gen pipeline still uses spm_old which keeps periods. that would change ranking signals.

maria: good catch. candidate generation used spm_old; reranker uses spm_new. i didn't realize the onboard script swapped tokenizer at convert-time.

andrew: that mismatch can change doc tokens and position embeddings => different KV caches. we should try aligning tokenizers for eval: run reranker with spm_old but model weights trained on spm_new?

kai: quick experiment idea: run eval with tokenizer forced to spm_old and with `--whitespace-normalize=False` and compare. also try `use_byte_fallback=true` to approximate legacy fallback behavior.

maria: ran two quick forks:
- forced spm_old: NDCG@10=0.703 MRR=0.431
- spm_new but with punctuation preserved flag: NDCG@10=0.675
so looks like tokenizer mismatch explains most of the drop.

raj: nice. for onboarding checklist: add a 'tokenizer parity' step and a small script to diff tokenized queries/docs. could be added to eval-harness.

maria: i'll open a PR with the script and add to model_onboard checklist. also flagging this could hide regressions if candidate gen and reranker disagree.

eval-bot: eval-bot: registered new run 1716543220 (maria) - artifacts uploaded: token-diffs.tar.gz

kai: :thumbsup: can you include a deterministic-seed note? also check padding/truncation direction — we saw earlier right-truncation causing anchor token loss.

maria: will do. also planning to run a small A/B comparing full-parity vs partial-parity on a random 10k sample.

andrew: one more ask: log sample where top-1 flips, include tokenized forms for both sides. that will make triage faster.

maria: yep. i'll post links when done.
